caption: The drawing depicts a four-poster wooden bed covered by a quilt with a geometric and floral patchwork pattern. The quilt has a repeating design composed of red, pink, and green shapes arranged mostly in square units with a white background; each square features a central motif resembling an open book or card, encircled by green, red, and pink border elements, and there is a floral wreath motif at the center-top of the quilt. The upper left of the image contains a black and white motif outline resembling a pattern template. The lower left contains a close-up showing embroidered pink roses, green leaves, and smaller yellow flowers along with some cursive handwritten text. The lower right contains another close-up, focusing on a single geometric pink petal-like shape set against white and green triangular segments with visible stitching. The name "Francis Law Durand" is written below the right-most detail image. The background of the drawing is off-white, and the composition includes fine linework and colored pencil or ink.
title: Quilt
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
